text:
Meet Hop to Olympus ☁️

A voxel action RPG in your browser. Hop across floating islands, fight gods and titans, raise a Kumo of your own.

No download. No sign-up.

Alpha test: opening soon. Follow to hear first.

Six worlds. One climb.

From the Cloud Isles to neon Horai: 19 regions and 33 bosses wait on the way up.

Which world do you want to see first? 👇

Not a single clone.

Gryphons, titans, gorgons, nightmares and neon dragons: 33 bosses with their own phases, arenas and legendary loot.

Which one would you fight first? 👇

Movement is the weapon.

Hop on the beat: every jump in a streak is faster, and the fifth one is a mega jump. Add a dash, wall-runs, a grappling hook and wings.

Skill beats stats here. #indiegame

Race your ghost.

Five time trial tracks, a ghost of your best run and shared leaderboards. Hops and dashes decide everything.

Can you beat yourself? 👇

Meet Kumo ☁️

A cloud buddy that hatches from an egg, grows, evolves and joins your adventures.

Ultra-rare form: 1% chance, and the odds are public.

What would you name yours? 👇

From egg to legend.

Feed it, care for it and watch your Kumo change: baby, teen, then one of six adult forms. And once in a hundred hatches, an ultra-rare.

Which form do you want? 👇

99% vs 1%.

Every Kumo hatch has a 1% chance to be ultra-rare. The odds are public, and every ultra-rare gets its own unique number.

No fog, no tricks. #indiegame

Loot it. Craft it. Equip it.

Mobs drop materials, and you forge armour, wings and legendary weapons: 32 items and 8 relics. The Starbreaker can only be forged in the Star Dome.

What would you craft first? 👇

Build your own map.

Place the start, finish and checkpoints, publish it, and earn creator stars: +1 for a new player, +2 for every finish, +5 for a like. Every map has its own leaderboard.

What would you build? 👇

1.47 MB.

That's the whole game: one file, zero installs. A custom voxel engine on Three.js and 140,000+ blocks, running in your browser.

Alpha test: opening soon. #buildinpublic

One game. Any screen.

Play on desktop, tablet or phone: keyboard and mouse, touch controls, or a gamepad (Xbox, PlayStation, Switch Pro).

No download. No sign-up.

Up to 32 players in one room.

Shared bosses, shared loot and XP. Honest co-op: the fight leader stays put, boss health is shared and hits are never dropped.

Who are you bringing? 👇

Built from scratch.

Our own voxel engine on Three.js, our own Node.js server with zero dependencies, and a 64×64 chunk world that keeps your device smooth.

Small studio, big island. #buildinpublic

Hop to Olympus by the numbers:

33 bosses
6 worlds
19 regions
12 weapon types
32 players per room
1.47 MB: the whole game
0 installs

Alpha test: opening soon.

The Gates of Olympus.

Marble, gold and portals: the climb gets serious up here. 19 regions, 33 bosses, 6 worlds.

What is waiting behind the gate? 👇

Above the clouds.

Keep climbing past the sky: the stars are a floor too.

No download. No sign-up.

Neon Horai.

The last world glows: Cloud Harbor, the Neon Quarter and the Jade Palace.

Which world do you want to see first? 👇

Inside the Star Dome.

The Starbreaker, one of 8 relics, can only be forged here. Bring a plan.

Which relic would you chase? 👇

Swing. Dash. Repeat.

12 weapon types, plus hops, dashes and a mega jump on every fifth hop. Pick your style.

Which weapon are you? 👇

Play together.

Up to 32 players in one room: shared bosses, shared loot and XP, and one shared boss health bar. Pick your hero and jump in.

Who is your co-op partner? 👇

33 bosses. All wanted.

Zeus, Medusa, Kronos and 30 more are waiting on the way up, each with its own arena and legendary loot. Hunt them solo or with up to 32 players.

Which boss is your first target? 👇

Your boarding pass to Olympus ✈️☁️

No download. No sign-up. Any screen. Co-op for up to 32 players.

Alpha test: opening soon. Follow to hear first.

Pick your hero.

Ginger, Rina or Sergio: three heroes, 12 weapon types and the same mega jump on every fifth hop.

Who are you playing? 👇

Today on the cloud: Kumo ☁️

Hatch an egg, feed and care for your Kumo, and watch it grow into one of six adult forms. One in a hundred hatches is ultra-rare, and the odds are public.

Which one are you hatching? 👇

Achievement unlocked.

Mega jump, Cloud rhythm, Free fall: skill beats stats in Hop to Olympus.

Which achievement would you go for first? 👇

Alpha test: opening soon.

Your craft receipt 🧾

3 mole claws + 5 slime = 1 grappling hook. Mobs drop materials, recipes turn them into gear: 32 items and 8 relics.

Where we are 🗺️

Shipped: the Cloud Isles, Chaos Rift, Star Dome, Horai, your island and Kumo.
In progress: a shared home for two, the alpha test, deeper RPG lore.
Next: Kumo cloud races, leaderboards, kingdoms, a vast open world.

Plans can change, and your feedback shapes them.
